evidence.title: Lando Norris releases statement after demanding F1 rival to be banned
evidence.body: [e003:f01] F1 world champion Lando Norris has issued an apology after calling for a rival driver to be banned by the FIA . [e003:f02] Norris was outspoken following Saturday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix where he was forced to retire after being involved in a collision at a restart following a safety car. [e003:f03] However, the McLaren star was not at fault, with Franco Colapinto outbreaking himself into turn one on cold tyres, causing him to lock up which then saw him crash into his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly , who could then do nothing but crash into Norris, causing all three cars to retire. [e003:f04] Article continues under video Colapinto was given a 10-second penalty as a result of being at fault for the crash, which he was unable to serve in Baku and therefore will have a five-place grid drop at this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang track in Malaysia instead. [e003:f05] After the race, a fuming Norris called on F1's governing body the FIA to take stricter action, even calling for the Argentine racer to be banned. [e003:f06] He said: "The FIA should be more strict and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff. [e003:f07] "It's careless from people. [e003:f08] It costs a lot of money. [e003:f09] All my parts are in the bin now, so people should just get banned for this kind of driving. (They) don't deserve to be in Formula 1. [e003:f10] "If you cause a crash on a restart like this, yeah, you should have at least a one-race ban." F1 HEADLINES: Christian Horner Ferrari speculation addressed and team boss reveals 'secret negotiations' Lando Norris released a statement on Instagram Norris U-turn But just two days after the incident, Norris has released a statement saying he apologised to Colapinto for his comments, reflecting on his own previous errors and that saying he had patched things up with the 23-year-old. [e003:f11] On his Instagram stories, Norris said: "Tough weekend overall in Baku and of course a disappointing and early end to the race. [e003:f12] "After the race, I sent Franco a message apologising for the comments I made that I simply should not have said. [e003:f13] "I know better and emotions were running high but that is not an excuse, it was wrong of me. [e003:f14] F1 drivers have been given a one-race ban for causing a crash at the start of the race before. [e003:f15] Romain Grosjean triggered an incident at the start of the 2012 Belgian Grand Prix after squeezing Lewis Hamilton into a wall at turn one, which then saw the Frenchman crash into Sergio Perez and Fernando Alonso , with Pastor Maldonado and Kamui Kobayashi suffering damage too courtesy of a helpless Hamilton. [e003:f16] Grosjean was fined €50,000 and given a one-race ban at the following race at Monza for the Italian Grand Prix.

evidence.title: Lewis Hamilton Azerbaijan GP update as Mercedes dominate
Honda find no 'problems' with F1 engine after Fernando Alonso retirement sparks investigation
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Chief engineer Shintaro Orihara has revealed that Honda's analysis has found no problems with Fernando Alonso's power unit, despite the Spaniard claiming it was the reason he retired from Saturday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [e004:f02] Honda's engine has been a real thorn in the side for Aston Martin so far this season, and the weekend in Baku proved to be another miserable outing for the team. [e004:f03] Lance Stroll was forced to retire from the race after suffering a water issue on lap nine, and unfortunately for the team, Alonso didn't make it much further. [e004:f04] Article continues under video After complaining over the radio that he was suffering from a power issue and being told back that there was 'nothing we can do at the moment' as the team investigated, Alonso called time on his race: "Yeah, but. [e004:f05] I think we will box at the end of this lap." F1 HEADLINES: Christian Horner Ferrari speculation addressed and team boss reveals 'secret negotiations' Fernando Alonso on Azerbaijan GP retirement Speaking to the media after the race, Alonso opened up further on the problems he was experiencing within the car. [e004:f06] "I passed the Cadillacs and Checo overtook me and pulled away," the Spaniard explained. [e004:f07] "Then I battled with Bottas, we passed each other several times, five or six times, and then we had to pit. [e004:f08] "We suspect there's an engine problem; the lack of speed on the straight was unusual. [e004:f09] We need to see why. [e004:f10] "There were no warning lights, everything was working fine, but I started losing almost a second and a half on the straight, so it must be something unusual." Initial Honda investigation finds no problems Despite those comments, Honda's initial analysis after the race in Baku has not found any problems with Alonso's power unit. [e004:f11] That doesn't mean there aren't gremlins still to be found, with a deeper investigation to come, but the Japanese manufacturer's initial analysis hasn't shown up anything yet. [e004:f12] "Based on the data we've reviewed so far, the engine is fine," Honda's chief engineer Orihara confirmed post-race, via AS . [e004:f13] "We don't see any problems in the data, but we'll review it carefully. [e004:f14] "We'll check the engine power, energy management, and GPS data." Perhaps a deeper analysis can provide Alonso and Aston Martin with the answers they are looking for, but they certainly don't have long to get on top of things. [e004:f15] F1 action gets back underway in just a few days , with action from the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia set to kick off in Sepang on Friday, October 2.

evidence.title: 1リッターで47km以上走る！ ホンダ「“新”原付二種スクーター」登場！ ガソリン満タンで265km航続可能＆ダイナミックな顔つきに進化！ 「SH Mode 125」2027年モデルを欧州で発表
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 「SH Mode 125」2027年モデルを欧州で発表 2026年9月29日 10時10分 くるまのニュース 写真拡大 利便性を高めたスクーターモデル ホンダ・ヨーロッパは2026年9月22日、スクーターモデル「SH Mode 125」の2027年モデルを発表しました。 [e005:f02] 最新モデルではフロント周りのデザインが刷新されたほか、フルカラーTFTディスプレイやUSB Type-Cソケットといった現代的な装備が新たに加わり、ヨーロッパ市場での通勤用スクーターとしての魅力がいっそう高まっています。 [e005:f03] 画像で見る（19枚） ホンダのSHシリーズは、1984年に登場した初代「SH50」をルーツに持ちます。 [e005:f04] スクーターブランドとして長年にわたり支持を集めてきた同シリーズは、累計販売台数が120万台を超え、ヨーロッパ各地の日常的な移動手段として広く定着しています。 [e005:f05] SHシリーズの派生モデルであるSH Mode 125は、2014年からヨーロッパでの販売を開始しました。 [e005:f06] より若い世代への訴求を意識したモデルとして生まれ、12年間の販売期間でヨーロッパにおける累計販売台数は15万2000台以上にのぼります。 [e005:f07] 2021年モデルでは大がかりな改良が施され、LEDヘッドライトや軽量高剛性スチール製フレーム「eSAF（enhanced Smart Architecture Frame）」、4バルブ水冷SOHC エンジン「eSP+（enhanced Smart Power Plus）」、省燃費タイヤを装着したアルミホイールが採用されています。 [e005:f08] 2027年モデルでまず目を引くのは、フロントフェイスの変更です。 [e005:f09] 技術面での主な刷新は、フルカラー4.2インチTFTディスプレイの採用です。 [e005:f10] 搭載される排気量125ccのエンジンは2021年モデルから受け継ぐ「eSP+」です。 [e005:f11] ボア・ストローク53.5×55.5mm、圧縮比11.5:1の4バルブ水冷SOHCエンジンで、最高出力は8.7kW ／8500rpm、最大トルクは12.0Nm／5000rpmを発生します。 [e005:f12] WMTC モードでの燃費は47.6km／リッターを達成しており、5.6L のタンク容量と組み合わせれば、満タン時の航続距離はおよそ265kmに達します。 [e005:f13] 車体には軽量プレス鋼板製のeSAFフレームを採用し、車両重量は118kgに収められています。 [e005:f14] ブレーキはフロントに220mm油圧ディスクブレーキ、リアに130mmドラムブレーキを採用し、CBS（コンバインド・ブレーキ・システム）によって前後が連動します。 [e005:f15] 今回の2027年モデルは、デザインと装備の両面でアップデートを重ねながらも、燃費性能や取り回しのよさといったSH Mode 125が長年培ってきた実用性をしっかりと継承しています。 [e005:f16] カワサキ「Ninja H2 SX SE」2027年モデル登場 10月より販売開始 関連情報（BiZ PAGE＋） 新幹線。

evidence.title: 新車394万円！ ホンダ新型「“5ドア”スポーツハッチ」に大注目！「画期的なシフト」＆「黒すぎるホイール」搭載でめちゃ進化！ さらに走りの楽しそうな“6速MT”採用で操る喜び極めた「新型シビック」とは！
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 2026年9月28日 10時10分 くるまのニュース 写真拡大 新車394万円！ [e006:f02] 2026年6月にホンダはスポーツハッチバック「シビック」のマイナーチェンジモデルを発表し、発売しました。 [e006:f03] シビックは1972年の登場からホンダの中核として長期間ラインナップされており、世界累計販売台数3000万台に迫る実績を持つグローバルモデルです。 [e006:f04] （50枚） 現行型は2021年9月発売の11代目となります。 [e006:f05] 海外市場では4ドアセダンもラインナップされていますが、日本国内では5ドアハッチバックのみ販売されています。 [e006:f06] 11代目では外装および内装のデザインを刷新しており、ホンダ独自の「VTEC」ターボエンジンや2モーターハイブリッドシステム「e:HEV」の搭載によって走行性能を向上させ、運転支援システム「Honda SENSING」の機能も強化しています。 [e006:f07] 2024年のマイナーチェンジでは、フロントデザインの変更およびe:HEVモデルの拡充を実施。 [e006:f08] 同時に、6速MTと専用の足回りを搭載し、走行性能を引き上げた新グレード「RS」を追加設定しています。 [e006:f09] そして先述の2026年6月のマイナーチェンジでは、RSグレードにe:HEVモデルが新たに設定されたほか、24年ぶりに復活を遂げたスペシャリティカー「プレリュード」で用いられている仮想有段シフト「Honda S+ Shift」を導入しています。 [e006:f10] 通常グレードにおいても外観や内装の仕様変更、装備の充実を図っています。 [e006:f11] また、RSにもマットブラックのアルミホイールを採用し、足元を引き締めています。 [e006:f12] グレード展開はe:HEVモデルがベーシックなe:HEV LX、中級のe:HEV EX、スポーティなe:HEV RSの3種類となっています。 [e006:f13] 1.5リッターVTECターボエンジンを搭載する標準モデルはEXとRSの2種類となり、このうち6速MTが用意されているのは標準モデルのRSのみです。 [e006:f14] マイナーチェンジ後のシビックの車両価格（消費税込）は、EXの394万6800円から、e:HEV RSの465万9600円に設定されています。 [e006:f15] （50枚） 約250万円の「“4人乗り”スポーツカー」がスゴイ！ [e006:f16] 20代の購入者が6年で倍増した理由とは 関連情報（BiZ PAGE＋） 新幹線。

evidence.title: McLaren silver lining as new MCL40 upgrade signals new development path
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Let’s take a detailed look at the extensive aerodynamic update package McLaren introduced at last weekend’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [e001:f02] The Baku race did not go to plan for the reigning constructors’ champions as Lando Norris retired and Oscar Piastri finished a lowly 13th. [e001:f03] Yet the arrival of the latest MCL40 is a silver lining, offering fresh hope that McLaren can reclaim its spot at the front of the field. [e001:f04] A new sidepod philosophy for the McLaren MCL40 With the most striking modifications visible on the car’s sidepods, we can see precisely what the factory engineers are striving to achieve. [e001:f05] Among others, the most eye-catching change on the MCL40 is undoubtedly the sidepod geometry – and for us, the most intriguing, as the team has completely shifted philosophy in this region. [e001:f06] Analysis: Azerbaijan Grand Prix Azerbaijan GP conclusions: Russell back in the game, Colapinto ban demand, untelevised Hamilton radio Azerbaijan GP 2026 Driver Ratings: Near perfection and the ultimate motorsport sin This creates an additional recessed channel (red arrow) – which could be described as a “dimple” – forming some kind of double undercut profile. [e001:f07] Furthermore, the lower lip of the inlet has been moved significantly further back compared to the previous specification (purple arrow). [e001:f08] MCL40 sidepod inlet comparison Managing front tyre wake has always been one of the most vital, and challenging, tasks for Formula 1 aerodynamicists. [e001:f09] With the new regulations making that task even more arduous, teams are forced to devise increasingly creative solutions. [e001:f10] Replacing their previous downwash profile that merged smoothly into the floor, McLaren have transitioned to a so-called overhang-style solution, similar to concepts adopted by several rivals. [e001:f11] This creates a larger undercut region and exposes significantly more of the floor’s upper surface. [e001:f12] MCL40 sidepod geometry comparation All of these elements must operate as a cohesive system. [e001:f13] Airspeed sensors (pitot rakes) mounted in this critical area confirm that engineers were actively validating whether real-world track data aligned with CFD simulations and wind tunnel models. [e001:f14] Rear floor geometry on McLaren car In conjunction with these sidepod revisions, the MCL40 features a updated rear corner assembly, playing its part within this revised aerodynamic structure. [e001:f15] All in all, this is a comprehensive upgrade package that impacts virtually every component on the car. evidence.title: F1 star slapped with penalty despite FIA admitting 'significant' safety car error
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The incident in question occurred between turns six and seven during the first lap after the first safety car restart around the Baku street circuit, with Bortoleto summoned to see the stewards after the race for an alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code and/or B5.13.2(c) of the FIA 2026 F1 Sporting Regulations – overtaking under yellow flags and/or safety car procedure. [e002:f02] Bortoleto went on to explain that he had been getting mixed information, with safety car boards having been displayed by some marshals at the time, despite the fact it had not yet been deployed again. [e002:f03] Article continues under video "BOR [Bortoleto] explained that he initially reacted to the SC [safety car] boards and Yellow Flags. [e002:f04] However, he did not see any corresponding electronic indication and did not receive a Safety Car indication on his steering wheel. [e002:f05] He was also informed by his Team that the Safety Car had not been deployed," the FIA confirmed. [e002:f06] "BOR therefore became uncertain as to the actual status of the Race and, not wishing to lose position unnecessarily, subsequently overtook PER [ Sergio Perez ]." The stewards accepted that the safety car display error 'contributed significantly' to Bortoleto's actions. [e002:f07] "The Stewards accept that the conflicting information contributed significantly to the situation," the FIA added. [e002:f08] "In particular, as the Safety Car had not been deployed, BOR cannot be considered to have overtaken another car under Safety Car conditions." F1 HEADLINES: Ferrari boss addresses Christian Horner speculation as champion calls for FIA ban Bortoleto slapped with 10-second time penalty However, despite making that admission, the FIA still punished Bortoleto for overtaking under yellow flags. [e002:f09] The Brazilian driver was given a 10-second penalty, dropping him from P13 down to P15. [e002:f10] "BOR confirmed that he had seen the Yellow Flags but explained that, because they were displayed together with the SC boards, he understood them to be part of the same Safety Car indication and therefore considered that they were no longer relevant once he had been informed that the Safety Car had not been deployed," the FIA explained. [e002:f11] "The Stewards do not accept this interpretation. [e002:f12] A waved Yellow Flag is an instruction in its own right and must be respected irrespective of any accompanying signal. [e002:f13] A driver cannot disregard a Yellow Flag based on his own assessment as to why it has been displayed or whether it should have been displayed. [e002:f14] The 2026 FIA practice likewise treats Yellow Flag indications as requiring compliance even where the surrounding circumstances are unusual. [e002:f15] Gabriel Bortoleto was demoted from P13 to P15 with his 10-second time penalty in Baku "Accordingly, notwithstanding the understandable confusion concerning the SC boards, BOR had seen the waved Yellow Flags and nevertheless overtook PER while the Yellow Flag condition remained in effect. [e002:f16] The Stewards therefore determine that BOR overtook another car under Yellow Flag conditions." evidence.title: Starship reaches orbit, releases 26 high-capacity 'V3' Starlink satellites
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Jeff Baumgartner , Senior Editor , Light Reading September 28, 2026 4 Min Read (Source: SpaceX via Flickr, CC2.0) It almost didn't happen, but Starship, SpaceX's heavy-duty rocket, successfully achieved orbit for the first time this morning. [e001:f02] Achieving orbit and reaching some of the test flight's key objectives were in jeopardy early into the test flight as one of the engines of the upper-stage "Ship" part of the rocket containing the payload was lost during the ascent. [e001:f03] Starship test flight 14 at liftoff. (Source: Screencapture of SpaceX live feed on September 28, 2026) For a few minutes, it appeared that the vehicle was not going to ignite the burn necessary to send it into orbit for the anticipated V3 deployment during Starship's 14 flight, which originated from the Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas. [e001:f04] If Starship remained in a suborbital trajectory, the plan was to have it land in the Indian Ocean, as it did in the prior test flight in late July . [e001:f05] Related: Starship completes first test flight with Starlink 'V3' satellites "The team has made the call not to commit to orbit ... [e001:f06] But he stressed that "we are not giving up yet on orbit." After running a series of additional checks, SpaceX changed its mind and determined about 22 minutes into the test flight that Starship was go for orbit and lit up a "Raptor" engine to send it there some three minutes later. [e001:f07] New 'V3' satellites to enter service soon About 12 minutes after that, the payload door opened to prepare for the deployment of the first of 26 V3 satellites, with each supporting about 1 Tbit/s of downlink capacity, 160 Gbit/s of uplink capacity – or a 10x improvement on the downlink and a 22x improvement on the uplink when compared to a Starlink V2 satellite. [e001:f08] The prior Starship test flight deployed 20 V3s, but those satellites were "demised" and sent to burn up in the Earth's atmosphere following a series of tests. [e001:f09] Starship deploys first Starlink 'V3' satellite during its September 28, 2026, test flight. (Source: Screencapture of SpaceX live video feed) After release, the V3s deployed today were to be instructed to unfold their antennas and their solar arrays, and then to raise their orbits via their onboard thrusters. [e001:f10] SpaceX confirmed that Starlink had made contact with all 26 V3s deployed today. [e001:f11] Related: Next Starship flight test to put first 'V3' Starlink satellites into orbit View post on X Following a suite of checks, SpaceX expects those V3s to start serving customers within a few weeks, but it didn't specify exactly when. [e001:f12] Today's deployment represented a subset of what Starship is capable of launching. [e001:f13] SpaceX noted that a fully loaded Starship can carry up to 60 V3s into orbit, and about 20x the capacity that can be delivered with the number of V2 satellites that can be sent up on a Falcon 9 rocket. [e001:f14] The plan today is for Starship to complete six orbits. [e001:f15] Update: SpaceX cut the mission short after completing three hours in orbit (rather than ten). evidence.title: After seeing 200 rocket launches, Starship was unlike anything I’ve experienced
evidence.body: [e004:f01] ET * SpaceX's Starship launched from South Texas, an event described by spectators as awe-inspiring and powerful. * The rocket successfully reached orbit for the first time and deployed Starlink satellites before its mission was cut short. * Onlookers, some of whom traveled internationally, felt the launch's intense sound and vibration from miles away. * SpaceX may launch a Starship from Florida's Kennedy Space Center by the end of the year. [e004:f02] SOUTH PADRE ISLAND, Texas — I've seen more than 200 Florida rocket launches and nothing prepared me for the moment when [SpaceX’s Starship roared to life](http:// on its Starbase launch pad in South Texas. [e004:f03] I cover space and launches for FLORIDA TODAY. [e004:f04] I've watched NASA's massive Space Launch System, Blue Origin's New Glenn, SpaceX's Falcon Heavy, United Launch Alliance's Atlas V and so many Falcon 9 liftoffs. [e004:f05] 28 in [South Padre Island](http:// approximately three miles from the Starbase launch pad, Starship was on another level. [e004:f06] My first reaction was awe over just how large this rocket is [compared to the others](http:// There are no other words to describe it but “a flying skyscraper." And then the sound hits you. [e004:f07] For context, it's about as far from the launch pad as Cape Canaveral is from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. [e004:f08] After some tense moments following the launch, the Starship was able to successfully reach orbit for the first time and deploy a batch of Starlink V3 satellites. [e004:f09] However, the SpaceX team decided to cut the mission short, choosing to land Starship after only three hours in orbit instead of the planned 10. ## Space enthusiasts react to a Starship launch Back on the ground at Isla Blanca Park, most spectators, including myself, lacked stable cell phone internet connection so we were completely unaware if the mission was successful or not. [e004:f10] At launch the crowd was silent. [e004:f11] This is the largest rocket ever made, and they’re making huge progress.” Austin Hernadez was buzzing as he walked to exit the park after liftoff. [e004:f12] He’s always been a space fan, but this Starship Flight 14 was his first rocket launch experience in person. [e004:f13] “It took a few seconds for it to travel to us, but once it did, it was exhilarating,” Hernadez said. [e004:f14] “I felt it throughout my entire body.” Space enthusiast Christopher Parker traveled down from Illinois to witness his first rocket launch. [e004:f15] It was like standing in front of an artillery barrage because it’s one constant sound.” Those in Florida might not have to wait much longer to experience Starship. [e004:f16] A launch from Kennedy Space Center Pad 39A could come by the end of the year as SpaceX readies to bring its 407-foot-tall Starship-Super Heavy rocket-booster combo to the Space Coast. _Brooke Edwards is a Space Reporter for Florida Today.

evidence.body: [e005:f01] 1, 2026, Indian spacetech startup TakeMe2Space will launch its MOI-1A orbital computing satellite aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. [e005:f02] The mission marks the operator’s transition to commercial flight operations following a previous launch failure during a test flight with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). [e005:f03] Spacecraft Architecture and Edge Computing Hardware Specifications The MOI-1A satellite is designed as an orbital data center engineered to execute space edge computing and artificial intelligence tasks directly in low Earth orbit. [e005:f04] The satellite bus houses commercial off-the-shelf processing hardware powered by Nvidia compute chips. [e005:f05] The onboard GPU architecture enables the spacecraft to run machine learning algorithms, process raw sensor imagery, and perform semantic data reduction prior to ground downlinking. [e005:f06] By analyzing data in orbit rather than transmitting raw files to terrestrial teleports, MOI-1A reduces downlink bandwidth constraints, allowing payload operators to receive processed analytics vectors in near real time. [e005:f07] Commercial Customer Manifest and Market Application The MOI-1A payload hosts compute allocations for 23 commercial, academic, and government customers across multiple industrial sectors. [e005:f08] Participating organizations utilize the spacecraft’s onboard processing power to run specialized algorithms for digital mapping, crop yield prediction in agriculture, land-use classification, and infrastructure risk assessment for the insurance industry. [e005:f09] Hosting third-party software container environments allows customers to upload custom AI models directly to the satellite while in orbit. [e005:f10] Launch Schedule and Flight Horizon Following encapsulation within the Falcon 9 payload fairing, the MOI-1A satellite will deploy into low Earth orbit during the Oct.
